overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the six late-filed items were laid on the table without substantive discussion, so the notice was not insufficient. The AG issued reminders about late-filed items and rule suspensions but ordered no remedy.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the February 4 meeting notice, including six late-filed orders and communications, was not sufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Because there was no discussion of the late filed orders at the February 4 meeting, we find no insufficiency in the notice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the six late-filed items were reasonably anticipated 48 hours before the meeting and so had to appear in the notice posted 48 hours before.
allegations.key_passage: Assuming arguendo that the late filed orders and communications were anticipated 48 hours prior to the February 4 meeting, they would need to be included on the notice only if they were actually discussed at the February 4 meeting.
